subtasks.description: Define complexity scoring data structures and core algorithm - create header files with ComplexityMetrics struct, scoring constants, and the main CalculateComplexityScore() function
Implement component analysis - count nodes, components, classify elements (linear/nonlinear, reactive/active), analyze source types (DC/AC/transient)
Implement topology analysis - analyze circuit connectivity, count independent loops, identify stiff systems, detect convergence-challenging structures
Implement simulation time prediction and memory estimation - create prediction models based on complexity metrics, implement memory usage estimation
Implement solver settings suggestion - based on complexity score and circuit characteristics, suggest appropriate solver type, tolerance, and iteration limits
Integrate complexity scoring into the system - add API endpoints, CLI commands, and wire all components together
